# @callstack/example-license-mit-or-apache-2.0

This is a test package with the license expression `MIT OR Apache-2.0` (a Dual License of two permissive licenses), for the needs of example tester projects in this monorepository to depend on, to test that license-kit parses, renders and classifies SPDX license expressions.

Expected category: permissive with `--or-policy most-restrictive` (the default), permissive with `--or-policy least-restrictive`.
